title: Adaptive Thrust Regulation in Solid-fuel Ramjet with Variable Geometry Inlet
summary: This paper presents the application of a novel data-driven adaptive control technique, dynamic mode adaptive control (DMAC), to regulate thrust in a solid-fuel ramjet (SFRJ). A quasi-static one-dimensional model of SFRJ with a variable geometry inlet is developed to compute thrust. An adaptive tracking controller is then designed using the DMAC framework, which leverages dynamic mode decomposition to approximate the local system behavior, followed by a tracking controller designed around the identified model.
